#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <limits.h>
using namespace std;

class Edge{
public:
    int u, flow, cost, rid;
    Edge(int a, int b, int c, int d){u = a; flow = b; cost = c; rid = d;}
};

class MinCostMaxFlow{
public:
    vector<vector<Edge>> al;
    Edge ja[1000][1000];
    int d[1000]; // shortest distances
    int N, S, T, maxFlow; int minCost;
    const int gmax = INT_MAX / 100;

    int edges = 0;

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost){
        int lu = al[u].size(), lv = al[v].size();
        al[u].push_back({v, flow, cost, lv});
        al[v].push_back({u, 0, -cost, lu});
    }

    void convertToArray(){
        for(int i = 0; i < N; i++){
            int sz = al[i].size();
            for(int j = 0; j < sz; j++){
                ja[i][j] = al[i][j];
            }
            al[i].clear();
        }
    }

    MinCostMaxFlow(int n, int source, int sink){
        N = n; S = source; T = sink; maxFlow = 0; minCost = 0;
        al = vector<vector<Edge>>(N);
        d = new int[N];
        for(int i = 0; i < N; i++){
            al[i].resize(0);
        }
    }

    bool BellmanFord(bool check){
        d[0] = 0;
        for(int i = 0; i < N - 1; i++){
            for(int j = 0; j < N; j++){
                for(Edge e : ja[j]){
                    if(e.flow == 0)continue;
                    d[e.u] = min(d[e.u], d[j] + e.cost);
                }
            }
        }
        if(check){
            for(int j = 0; j < N; j++){
                for(Edge e : ja[j]){
                    if(e.flow == 0)continue;
                    if(d[j] + e.cost < d[e.u]) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    int node[1000]; // present node
    int visit[1000]; // 0 -> not added 1 -> not removed 2 -> removed
    int prv[1000], prve[1000]; // previous node for augmentation
    int dist[1000]; // min dist

    bool simple(){
        node[0] = S; dist[0] = 0;
        int front = 1, back = 0;
        while(front != back){
            int u = node[back++]; int distu = dist[u];
            if(back == N)back = 0;
            visit[u] = 2;
            for(int i = 0; i < ja[u].size(); i++){
                Edge e = ja[u][i];
                if(e.flow == 0)continue;
                int cdist = distu + e.cost;
                if(cdist < dist[e.u]){
                    if(visit[e.u] == 0){
                        node[front] = e.u;
                        if(++front == N)front = 0;
                    }else if(visit[e.u] == 2){
                        if(--back == -1)back += N;
                        node[back] = e.u;
                    }
                    visit[e.u] = 1;
                    prve[e.u] = i; prv[e.u] = u; dist[e.u] = cdist;
                }
            }
        }
        return visit[T] != 0;
    }

    class pair{
    public:
        int F; int S;
        pair(int a, int b){F = a; S = b;}
    };

    bool dijkstra(){
        visit = new int[N];
        prv = new int[N];
        prve = new int[N];
        dist = new int[N]; memset(dist, 63, sizeof(int) * N);
        priority_queue<pair, vector<pair>, greater<pair>> pq;

        pq.push({S, 0}); dist[0] = 0;
        while(!pq.empty()){
            pair p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            while(dist[p.F] < p.S){
                if(pq.empty()) break;
                p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            }
            visit[p.F] = 2;
            for(int i = 0; i < ja[p.F].size(); i++){
                Edge e = ja[p.F][i];
                if(e.flow == 0)continue;
                int cdist = p.S + (e.cost + d[p.F] - d[e.u]);
                if(cdist < dist[e.u]){
                    if(visit[e.u] == 2) return false;
                    pq.push({e.u, cdist});
                    dist[e.u] = cdist; prv[e.u] = p.F; prve[e.u] = i;
                    visit[e.u] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return visit[T] != 0;
    }

    int augment(){
        int p = T; int min = 63;
        while(p != 0){
            int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
            int val = ja[pp][pe].flow;
            min = min < val ? min : val;
            p = pp;
        }
        p = T;
        while(p != 0){
            int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
            ja[pp][pe].flow -= min;
            ja[p][ja[pp][pe].rid].flow += min;
            p = pp;
        }
        maxFlow += min;
        return min;
    }

    bool calSimple(){
        while(simple()){
            minCost += dist[T] * augment();
        }
        return true;
    }

    void updPotential(){
        for(int i = 0; i < N; i++){
            if(visit[i] != 0){
                d[i] += dist[i] - dist[S];
            }
        }
    }

    bool calWithPotential(){
        while(dijkstra()){
            int min = dist[T] + d[T] - d[S];
            minCost += min * augment();
            updPotential();
        }
        return true;
    }
};

int n, m, k, c, d, a[1000], f[1000];

void solve(int testNumber, istream &in, ostream &out) {
    in >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
    int maxl = n + k, T = n * maxl + 1;
    MinCostMaxFlow ans = MinCostMaxFlow(T + 1, 0, T);
    a = new int[k + 1]; f = new int[n + 1];
    for(int i = 1; i <= k; i++){
        in >> a[i];
        f[a[i]]++;
    }
    for(int i = 1; i <= n; i++){
        if(f[i] == 0)continue;
        ans.addEdge(0, i, f[i], 0);
    }
    for(int i = 2; i <= n; i++){
        for(int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++){
            ans.addEdge(l * n + i, (l + 1) * n + i, k, c);
        }
    }
    for(int i = 1; i <= m; i++){
        int a, b; in >> a >> b;
        for(int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++){
            for(int p = 1; p <= k; p++){
                if(a != 1)
                    ans.addEdge(n * l + a, n * (l + 1) + b, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                if(b != 1)
                    ans.addEdge(n * l + b, n * (l + 1) + a, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
            }
        }
    }
    for(int l = 1; l < maxl; l++){
        ans.addEdge(l * n + 1, T, k, 0);
    }
    ans.convertToArray();
    ans.calWithPotential();
    if(ans.maxFlow != k){
        out << "BUG" << endl;
    }else{
        out << ans.minCost << endl;
    }
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    int testNumber = 1;
    for(int i = 0; i < testNumber; i++){
        solve(i, cin, cout);
    }
    return 0;
}
